hpe_js_create.brief: 创建并初始化一个 JS 解释器实例 / Create and initialise a JS interpreter instance
hpe_js_create.return: 新的解释器实例；失败时返回 `NULL` / The new interpreter instance, or `NULL` on failure
hpe_js_create.note: 实例内部自带 arena、全局对象与各内建原型，随后由 `hpe_js_destroy` 整体释放 / The instance owns its arena, global object and builtin prototypes, all released as a whole by `hpe_js_destroy`

hpe_js_destroy.brief: 销毁解释器并释放其全部内存 / Destroy an interpreter and release all its memory

params.js: inout:要销毁的解释器实例 / The interpreter instance to destroy

hpe_js_destroy.note: arena 整体释放，实例内一切对象随之失效 / The arena is freed wholesale, invalidating every object it owned

hpe_js_set_global_host.brief: 把一个宿主对象暴露为全局变量 / Expose a host object as a global

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.name: 全局变量名（如 `document`）/ The global name, such as `document`
params.ptr: 宿主对象指针 / The host object pointer
params.type: 宿主类型标记（`HPE_HOST_*`）/ Host type tag
params.vt: 可选的属性拦截虚表 / Optional property-access vtable

hpe_js_set_global_host.note: 典型用法是把 `document` 挂到全局，使脚本可直接访问 / The typical use is exposing `document` so scripts can reach it directly

hpe_js_eval.brief: 执行一段脚本 / Run a script

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.source: 脚本源码 / Script source text
params.errbuf: out:接收错误信息，可为 `NULL` / Receives the error message, may be `NULL`
params.errbuf_size: `errbuf` 的容量（字节）/ Capacity of `errbuf` in bytes

hpe_js_eval.return: 成功返回 0，出错返回非 0 / 0 on success, non-zero on error
hpe_js_eval.note: 出错时把信息写入 `errbuf` / The error text is written to `errbuf` on failure

hpe_js_eval_module.brief: 按 ES 模块执行一段脚本 / Run a script as an ES module

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.source: 模块源码 / Module source text
params.dir: 解析相对 `import` 说明符的基准目录 / Base directory used to resolve relative `import` specifiers
params.errbuf: out:接收错误信息，可为 `NULL` / Receives the error message, may be `NULL`
params.errbuf_size: `errbuf` 的容量（字节）/ Capacity of `errbuf` in bytes

hpe_js_eval_module.return: 成功返回 0，出错返回非 0 / 0 on success, non-zero on error
hpe_js_eval_module.note: 允许 `import`/`export` 语法；模块解析器由 `hpe_js_set_module_loader` 注册 / `import` and `export` syntax are allowed; the resolver is registered via `hpe_js_set_module_loader`

hpe_js_call.brief: 从 C 侧调用一个可调用的值 / Call a callable value from C

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.callee: 被调用的值（如事件处理函数）/ The value to call, such as an event handler
params.thisv: 调用时的 `this` 值 / The `this` value of the call
params.args: 实参数组，`argc` 为 0 时可为 `NULL` / Argument array, may be `NULL` when `argc` is 0

hpe_js_call.return: 成功返回 0，运行时错误返回 -1 / 0 on success, -1 on a runtime error
hpe_js_call.note: 运行时错误会报告到 stderr / Runtime errors are reported to stderr

hpe_js_run_timers.brief: 执行到期定时器与一轮 rAF 回调 / Run due timers plus one round of rAF callbacks

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.now: 当前时间（秒），与定时器到期时刻同基准 / Current time in seconds, on the same basis as the deadlines
params.fired: out:实际上执行的回调个数，可为 `NULL` / The number of callbacks that actually ran; may be `NULL`

hpe_js_run_timers.return: 实际执行的回调个数 / The number of callbacks that actually ran
hpe_js_run_timers.note: 宿主可据 `*fired` 决定是否重排重绘 / The embedder can decide whether to relayout and repaint from `*fired`

hpe_js_set_module_loader.brief: 注册 `import` 说明符的解析器 / Register the resolver for `import` specifiers

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.loader: 模块加载器回调结构 / The module-loader callback structure

hpe_js_set_current_dir.brief: 设置相对说明符的基准目录 / Set the base directory for relative specifiers

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.dir: 基准目录 / The base directory

hpe_js_set_current_dir.note: 相对 `import` 说明符以此目录为起点解析 / Relative `import` specifiers are resolved from this directory
